ignoredTerms.reason: Ordinary programming word: pi's ExtensionContext type and our MessageContext (the data a message is built from). Neither names a Zone.
Ordinary word: process environment variables ("environment variable", the env object of the Claude bridge). Neither names a Zone.
Node's ErrnoException type for file system errors. It is not an Override.
rejectUnknownFields validates the config file against its schema. It is not a Block.
The list of field names a config object may have. It is not a Match.

allowedUses.reason: pi names the session directory ctx.cwd and child_process takes a cwd option. These names carry that value in and out; the resolved Place is never called cwd.

The glossary allows the word for pi-multi-pass display names (multiPassLabel), and pi's auth status has a label field. The rest is the display text of a select row or of a status line. None of it names a Zone tag.
Describes an Auth source in words (OAuth login, Claude Code login). The glossary definition of Auth source itself says "a stored login"; no Account is called a login.
The `subscriptions` key of the pi-multi-pass file format that the file is read from. Not our name for an Account.
Names the provider id argument or the config key `provider` in usage lines and messages, where the text around it makes clear it is the id half of an Account.
